title: The Cosmos
description: Public-domain views of deep space from Hubble and the James Webb Space Telescope.

items.title: Hubble reveals the Ring Nebula’s true shape
items.description_narrative: This stunning photograph, captured by the Hubble Space Telescope, unveils the intricate and true three-dimensional structure of the Ring Nebula. The image provides unprecedented detail, showcasing the nebula's complex shells of gas and dust as seen through advanced astronomical imaging.
items.tags: astronomy, space, nebula, hubble, cosmic, celestial, scientific imaging, photograph

items.title: Hubble reveals heart of Lagoon Nebula
items.description_narrative: This striking photograph, captured by the Hubble Space Telescope, offers an unprecedented close-up view into the turbulent core of the Lagoon Nebula. It reveals intricate structures of gas and dust sculpted by powerful stellar winds and intense ultraviolet radiation from massive young stars.

items.title: Most Detailed Image of the Crab Nebula
items.description_narrative: This photograph captures the intricate and explosive remnants of the Crab Nebula, a supernova observed in 1054 CE. items.title: Ant Nebula
items.description_narrative: This photograph captures the Ant Nebula, a planetary nebula designated Mz 3, formed by the expansion of a dying star's outer layers. Its distinctive hourglass shape, reminiscent of an ant's head and thorax, results from complex interactions within the stellar material.
